title: aggregate_records with a 4-hop dotted groupBy (purchase_order.requisition.requester.department.name) answers 500 DATABASE_ERROR instead of a 4xx
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

In the scenario half of `qa#1` routine round 2 (requisition_to_receipt `ordered_by_department`, Run and Iterate, subject `f6f5b50a`), the MCP tool `aggregate_records` on a child object, with `groupBy` `purchase_order.requisition.requester.department.name`, answered `500 DATABASE_ERROR`. The agent recovered on its own, so no check failed.

**Repro:** `aggregate_records` on a child object with a 4-hop dotted `groupBy` path.

**Expected:** either the grouping works, or the door refuses the path with a 4xx that names the hop limit or the unsupported path, so an MCP agent can change its approach. Related closed cards on dimensions through lookups, all different shapes: #33664, #29304, #21232.

Found by: `qa#1` routine round 2, scenario half (round record on #31433).
